scope: Typed coordinator and compatible weather/history observation adapters; card lifecycle/render wiring owned by integrator

behavior.deduplication: one in-flight request and refresh timer per host/query
behavior.scope: explicit options.scope, otherwise HA connection identity, otherwise callService plus query transport identity
behavior.stale: snapshot flag preserves prior data through refresh and failure
behavior.visibility: all hidden observers stop timers and invalidate current generation
behavior.release: idempotent; final active release stops timers and ignores obsolete completion
behavior.retry: visible errors retry at 30/60/120/240/300 seconds, bounded by configured refresh interval
behavior.cache: up to 64 idle snapshots per weakly held host scope; no eviction timers
behavior.legacy: weatherForecast and energyHistory remain compatible direct request wrappers

integration: observeCardData(hass, {type: 'forecast' | 'history', entityId}, listener, {visible?, freshnessMs?, refreshMs?, scope?})
Store observation per card/query; call setVisible for document and intersection visibility
Release on entity/kind/host replacement and disconnect; preserve observation across equivalent HA state object replacements
On reconnect or supported-feature changes use refresh({invalidate:true})
Surface snapshot status and stale flag; never replace denied or failed requests with a misleading empty success
acceptanceLimits: Unabortable existing HA transports may finish network work after release; their results are discarded
No live household, HACS or device acceptance implied
summary: Share weather and history requests with visibility controls and explicit data states.
